title: Seafood paella with prawns and mussels
steps: Wash the mussels and discard any open or damaged ones; chop the onion, garlic and pepper.
Soften them in the oil in a large pan for 5 minutes, add the paprika and saffron and cook the tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, pour in the hot stock, season and simmer for 12 minutes without stirring.
Spread the fish pieces, prawns, mussels and peas over the rice, cover and cook for 8–10 minutes until the mussels open (discard any that stay closed).
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon wedges and parsley.
